title: Brazil's Federal Police run Operação Revelatio against a group that shared government-system credentials on the dark web
date_note: Both articles, published 27 November, say the operation was carried out on Friday 27 November.
geo_basis: city where the search warrant was served, as stated by the articles
summary: Metrópoles and Correio Braziliense report that Brazil's Federal Police (PF) served a search-and-seizure warrant from the 1st Federal Criminal Court of Montes Claros in Coronel Fabriciano (MG) on 27 November. Per the PF, the investigated group shared access credentials for government websites and platforms in closed groups on the dark web. The PF also found signs of racism and Nazi apologia among some members.
plain: Brazil's Federal Police searched a suspected hacker's home in Minas Gerais. They are investigating a group that shared logins to government websites on the dark web.
exec: Credentials to government systems were reportedly shared on the dark web, and police acted on 27 November; the articles give no figures.
action: The PF advises public servants to keep access credentials personal, not share passwords, update them regularly and avoid suspicious links and attachments.
impact: The articles give no figures on members, seizures or arrests.

validation.note: Metrópoles and Correio Braziliense each report the PF's operation and its statement; the PF's own page was not found.
